concept.name: aperture fold / delayed landing open
concept.force_task_problem: a freely ballistic body must locally collapse its silhouette to pass a narrow wall aperture without touching it; clearance forces a late asymmetric reopening, which creates a one-foot landing deficit that must be paid after ground acquisition
concept.novelty_vs_prior: unlike Airborne022 the obstacle never grants contact/support; unlike 023/024 there is no anchor or planted tool; unlike 025/027 there is no net/payload custody; unlike 026/030 there is no collision impulse; unlike 028 there is no moving support; unlike 029 there is no midair recoil vector bend. The root remains ballistic while local envelope management alone creates downstream landing debt.
concept.support_law: BOTH_FEET at load; NONE through support break, aperture clearance and late reopening; RIGHT_FOOT only on first catch/crush; BOTH_FEET only after delayed restack
concept.contact_law: aperture contact is NONE in every key and transition; visible clearance is the task. Contact occurs only with ground at K8.
concept.clearance_law: body crosses wall columns x=52..54 only through opening rows 9..20; K4 initiates asymmetric fold before the wall, K5 compacts inside the opening, K6 retains trailing-heel lag after root passage
